items.statement: The investigation defines candidate/state generation, deduplication, advancement and validation, and attempts all three named molecules.
items.expected: Computed candidate/state coverage is explicit and every attempted object retains identity and failure context.

items.statement: A common, justified rule selects SOC-relevant triplets relative to S1 and validates state labels by energies.
items.expected: Per-isomer S1/triplet energies and the selection rule are reported, with SOC pair identities.

items.statement: The evaluator, not the agent, compares computed molecular evidence with the private experimental lifetime reference. SOC/state-character evidence remains required.
items.expected: Evaluator-private comparison: source PVA lifetimes are CZ1B 3.96 s, CZ4B 4.27 s, CZ2B 5.20 s (main PDF p.3 Fig.1d/f, 0.5 wt% films). Compare these with the submitted computed cross-isomer SOC/state-character evidence. Do not require the agent to state or guess the hidden lifetime values or observed ordering. Isolated SOC is not a formula for absolute film lifetime and does not alone prove host causation.
